name: Flying attack droid
description: Flying attack droids were a type of floating, spherical droid that the merchant Tuut Orial sold from a stall on the asteroid Port Borgo around 9 ABY. During a demonstration of the droids, one poked an Aqualish observer in the eye and another chased the child KB. The droid SM-33 later punched a flying attack droid out of the air while defending KB and her friends.
